findings: No backdrop arch, white reflective cap, or collision is visible in the inspected encoded samples. This is a sampled visual observation, not all-frame visual proof.
Native bands mask parts of close bars during the flight. Intermediate views are deliberately incomplete and cannot be used for common-scale screen comparisons.
Quarter-second samples show geometrically plausible close passes and turn; sparse edge-on views remain motion advisories rather than unreported defects.
No labels are visible at frame 324 (13.500s); frame 325 shows the fade; by frame 330 (13.750s) labels are fully legible. The final sampled frame 443 retains them.
The roughly five-second low-change ending aligns with the declared reading hold; it does not look like a missing scene in the inspected samples.
Both portrait check reports retain explicit 80-percent title-safe warnings. Actual inspected text is inside the image with no clipping.
Draft native videos are 960x540 or 540x960 at 24 fps for 444 frames (18.5s). Full authored-size stills do not establish full-resolution final video quality.

encodedCheckerAssessment.disposition: method defensible within explicit fixture and sampling scope
encodedCheckerAssessment.barHeightMethod: Derives height from source values, axis domain, projected zero baselines and one common parallel-plane factor; per-bar exported top positions are not reused. Analytic distance-based factors independently agree within 1e-6.
encodedCheckerAssessment.barHeightTolerance: Every fully labeled ending frame is checked at each bar centerline, with a 3px edge tolerance; this is bounded raster accuracy, not exact pixel or filled-area proof.
encodedCheckerAssessment.registrationMethod: Removing only a constant per-channel bias is reasonable for spatial/timing consistency while retaining raw errors and leaving color fidelity unaccepted.
encodedCheckerAssessment.registrationScope: Nine times per clip: 36 same-time samples and 72 adjacent comparisons total. Stationary or nearly stationary samples can tie adjacent frames; this does not uniquely prove every encoded frame clock.
encodedCheckerAssessment.notRerunByReviewer: The reviewer inspected the code and independently verified current input/output hashes and analytic plane factors; the parent ran the full encoded checker.
